title: Meme: 30 new ads, Meta sees one
hook: Thirty new looks. One buyer, one reason.
caption:
Thirty new looks. One buyer, one reason.

If every ad in the batch talks to the same person, at the same moment, with the same pitch, Meta's new system reads them as close to one ad.

Different backdrop. Same buyer. Same result.

Tag the person who briefs “just make 30 variations” 😅
(We still love you.)
alt_text: Statement card in Galvor violet and gold. Text: Agency: here are 30 new ads. Meta: cool, that's one ad. Below: different backdrops, same buyer, same reason.
